          } catch (e) {
            return null;

          localStorage.removeItem("sitkapai_" + k);

          return Object.keys(localStorage).filter(k =>
            k.startsWith("sitkapai_"),

      function guruOpts(sel = "", req = true) {
        const g = realGuru();
        let h = `<select class="form-select" ${req ? "required" : ""} data-field="guruId"><option value="">-- Pilih Guru Binaan --</option>`;
        g.forEach(

      function esc(s) {
        if (s === null || s === undefined) return "";
        return String(s)
          .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
          .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
          .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
          .replace(/"/g, "&quot;");
      }
      function getGuruById(id) {

      function calcProgress() {
        const guru = realGuru();
        if (!guru.length)
          return {
            total: 0,
            direncanakan: 0,
            dipantau: 0,
            dinilai: 0,
            dibina: 0,
            dievaluasi: 0,
            pct: 0,
          };
        let dr = 0,
          dp = 0,
          dn = 0,
          db = 0,
          de = 0;
        guru.forEach(g => {
          if (DB.get("rencana_" + g.id)) dr++;
          if (DB.get("pemantauan_" + g.id)) dp++;
          if (DB.get("penilaian_" + g.id)) dn++;
          if ((DB.get("pembinaan_" + g.id) || []).length) db++;
          if ((DB.get("rtl_" + g.id) || []).length) de++;
        });
        const pct = Math.round(
          ((dr + dp + dn + db + de) / (guru.length * 5)) * 100,
        );
        return {
          total: guru.length,
          direncanakan: dr,
          dipantau: dp,
          dinilai: dn,
          dibina: db,
          dievaluasi: de,
          pct,
        };
      }

                  backgroundColor: [
                    "#059669",
                    "#0B6E3D",
                    "#D4A843",
                    "#F59E0B",
                    "#DC2626",
                  ],
                  borderRadius: 6,
                },
              ],
            },
            options: {
              ...cOpt,
              plugins: { ...cOpt.plugins, legend: { display: false } },
            },
          }),
        );
        chartInstances.push(
          new Chart(document.getElementById("chartProgres"), {
            type: "bar",
            data: {
              labels: [
                "Merencanakan",
                "Memantau",
                "Menilai",
                "Membina",
                "Mengevaluasi",
              ],
              datasets: [
                {
                  label: "Jumlah Guru",
                  data: [
                    p.direncanakan,
                    p.dipantau,
                    p.dinilai,
                    p.dibina,
                    p.dievaluasi,
                  ],
                  backgroundColor: [
                    "#1E40AF",
                    "#7C3AED",
                    "#D97706",
                    "#DC2626",
                    "#059669",
                  ],
                  borderRadius: 6,
                },
                {
                  label: "Total Guru",
                  data: Array(5).fill(p.total),
                  backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,.06)",
                  borderRadius: 6,
                },
              ],
            },
            options: {
              ...cOpt,
              scales: {
                x: { grid: { display: false } },
                y: { beginAtZero: true, grid: { color: "rgba(0,0,0,.05)" } },
              },
            },
          }),
        );
        // Predikat chart
        const predCount = {
          "Prioritas pembinaan": 0,
          "Perlu penguatan": 0,
          "Cukup": 0,
          "Kuat": 0,
          "Sangat kuat": 0,
        };
        guru.forEach(g => {
          const pen = DB.get("penilaian_" + g.id);
          if (pen && Object.hasOwn(predCount,pen.predikatKompetensi))
            predCount[pen.predikatKompetensi]++;
        });
        chartInstances.push(
          new Chart(document.getElementById("chartPredikat"), {
            type: "doughnut",
            data: {
              labels: Object.keys(predCount),
              datasets: [
                {
                  data: Object.values(predCount),
                  backgroundColor: [
                    "#DC2626",
                    "#D97706",
                    "#1E40AF",
                    "#059669",
                    "#047857",
                  ],
                  borderWidth: 0,
                },
              ],
            },
            options: cOpt,
          }),
        );
      }

      /* ===================== DATA GURU ===================== */
      function renderGuru() {
        const all = supervisionGuruRecords();
        const filtered = all.filter(
          g =>
            !searchQ ||
            String(g.nama ?? "").toLocaleLowerCase("id-ID").includes(searchQ.trim().toLocaleLowerCase("id-ID")) ||
            String(g.sekolah ?? "").toLocaleLowerCase("id-ID").includes(searchQ.trim().toLocaleLowerCase("id-ID")),
        );
        const perPage = 15,
          totalPages = Math.ceil(filtered.length / perPage) || 1;
        if (guruPage > totalPages) guruPage = totalPages;
        const start = (guruPage - 1) * perPage,
          pageData = filtered.slice(start, start + perPage);
        let rows = "";
        pageData.forEach((g, i) => {
          const akkClass =
            g.akreditasi === "A"
              ? "badge-green"
              : g.akreditasi === "B"
                ? "badge-blue"
                : g.akreditasi === "C"
                  ? "badge-yellow"
                  : g.akreditasi === "TT"
                    ? "badge-red"
                    : "badge-gray";
          const stsClass =
            g.statusSekolah === "Negeri" ? "badge-green" : "badge-yellow";
          rows += `<tr><td>${start + i + 1}</td><td>${esc(g.nama)}</td><td>${esc(g.sekolah)}</td><td><span class="badge ${stsClass}">${g.statusSekolah}</span></td><td><span class="badge ${akkClass}">${g.akreditasi}</span></td>
    <td><button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline" data-action="editGuru" data-id="${g.id}"><i class="fas fa-edit"></i></button> <button class="btn btn-sm btn-danger" data-action="delGuru" data-id="${g.id}"><i class="fas fa-trash"></i></button></td></tr>`;
        });
        let pag = "";
        for (let i = 1; i <= totalPages; i++)
          pag += `<button class="${i === guruPage ? "active" : ""}" data-action="guruPage" data-p="${i}">${i}</button>`;
        return `<div class="card">
  <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px">
    <h3 class="section-title" style="margin:0">Data Guru Binaan (${all.length})</h3>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center">
      <input class="form-input" style="width:220px" placeholder="Cari nama/sekolah..." value="${esc(searchQ)}" data-field="searchGuru">
      <button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" data-action="addGuru"><i class="fas fa-plus"></i> Tambah Guru</button>
      <input type="file" id="guruExcelInput" accept=".xlsx,.xls,.csv" style="display:none">
      <button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" data-action="chooseGuruExcel"><i class="fas fa-file-import"></i> Impor Excel</button>
      <button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" data-action="downloadGuruTemplate"><i class="fas fa-download"></i> Template</button>
      <button class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" data-action="exportGuru"><i class="fas fa-file-pdf"></i> PDF</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="app-help"><strong>Impor data guru:</strong> unduh template standar, isi tanpa mengubah nama kolom, lalu pilih <em>Impor Excel</em>. Kolom wajib: Nama Guru, Nama Sekolah, dan Jenjang.</div>
  <div style="overflow-x:auto">${
    pageData.length
      ? `<table class="data-table"><thead><tr><th>No</th><th>Nama Guru</th><th>Nama Sekolah</th><th>Status</th><th>Akreditasi</th><th>Aksi</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows}</tbody></table>`
      : '<div style="text-align:center;padding:40px;color:var(--muted)">Belum ada data guru binaan</div>'
  }</div>
  ${totalPages > 1 ? `<div class="pagination">${pag}</div>` : ""}
  </div>
  <div id="guruModal"></div>`;
      }

  <div style="margin-top:20px;display:flex;gap:8px">

      function renderPmDynamic(d) {
        const t = d.tujuan;
        if (!t)
          return '<div style="padding:20px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted)">Pilih tujuan pemantauan untuk menampilkan instrumen</div>';
        let h = '<div class="card" style="margin-top:16px">';
        if (t !== "manajerial") {
          h +=
            '<h4 style="font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--primary-dark);margin-bottom:12px">Kelengkapan Instrumen Pemantauan / Observasi</h4>';
          h += `<table class="checklist-table"><thead><tr><th>No</th><th>Instrumen</th><th>Tersedia</th></tr></thead><tbody>
    <tr><td>1</td><td>Modul Ajar / RPP tersedia dan lengkap</td><td><input type="checkbox" data-field="pmRpp" ${d.kelengkapan.rpp ? "checked" : ""}></td></tr>
    <tr><td>2</td><td>Jadwal Pelajaran terpampang jelas</td><td><input type="checkbox" data-field="pmJadwal" ${d.kelengkapan.jadwal ? "checked" : ""}></td></tr>
    <tr><td>3</td><td>Absensi Siswa tercatat dengan rapi</td><td><input type="checkbox" data-field="pmAbsensi" ${d.kelengkapan.absensi ? "checked" : ""}></td></tr>
    <tr><td>4</td><td>Daftar Nilai / Buku Nilai</td><td><input type="checkbox" data-field="pmNilai" ${d.kelengkapan.nilai ? "checked" : ""}></td></tr>
    </tbody></table>`;
        }
        if (t === "akademik") {
          h +=
            '<h4 style="font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--primary-dark);margin:16px 0 12px">Hasil Observasi Supervisi Akademik</h4>';
          h += `<div class="form-group"><label>Kegiatan Pendahuluan (Salam, Doa, Apersepsi)</label><textarea class="form-textarea" data-field="pmPendahuluan">${esc(d.obsAkademik.pendahuluan)}</textarea></div>
    <div class="form-group"><label>Kegiatan Inti (Penerapan Materi dan Metode)</label><textarea class="form-textarea" data-field="pmInti">${esc(d.obsAkademik.inti)}</textarea></div>
    <div class="form-group"><label>Kegiatan Penutup (Refleksi dan Kesimpulan)</label><textarea class="form-textarea" data-field="pmPenutup">${esc(d.obsAkademik.penutup)}</textarea></div>`;
        }
        if (t === "manajerial") {
          h +=
            '<h4 style="font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--primary-dark);margin-bottom:12px">Hasil Observasi Supervisi Manajerial — Aspek Manajemen & Kurikulum</h4>';
          h +=
            '<p style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:12px">Menilai dukungan kebijakan sekolah terhadap pengembangan PAI</p>';
          h += `<table class="checklist-table"><thead><tr><th>No</th><th>Indikator</th><th>Ada</th><th>Tidak Ada</th><th>Catatan/Bukti Fisik</th></tr></thead><tbody>`;
          d.obsManajerial.forEach((m, i) => {
            h += `<tr><td>${i + 1}</td><td>${esc(m.ind)}</td><td style="text-align:center"><input type="radio" name="manj_${i}" value="Ada" ${m.ada === "Ada" ? "checked" : ""} data-field="manjAda" data-idx="${i}"></td>
      <td style="text-align:center"><input type="radio" name="manj_${i}" value="Tidak Ada" ${m.ada === "Tidak Ada" ? "checked" : ""} data-field="manjTidak" data-idx="${i}"></td>
      <td><input class="form-input" style="min-width:180px" value="${esc(m.catatan)}" data-field="manjCatatan" data-idx="${i}"></td></tr>`;
          });
          h += "</tbody></table>";
        }
        h += "</div>";
        return h;
      }

          h += `<div class="card" style="margin-bottom:14px"><h4 style="font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--primary-dark)">${kom.title}</h4><p style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:10px">${kom.desc}</p>
    <table class="checklist-table"><thead><tr><th>No</th><th>Indikator</th><th>Level</th></tr></thead><tbody>`;
          kom.indikator.forEach((ind, i) => {
            let opts = '<option value="0">-- Pilih Level --</option>';
            for (let l = 1; l <= 5; l++)
              opts += `<option value="${l}" ${d[kom.key][i] === l ? "selected" : ""}>Level ${l} — ${LEVEL_LABELS[l - 1]}</option>`;
            h += `<tr><td>${i + 1}</td><td>${ind}</td><td><select class="level-select" data-field="nilai_${kom.key}_${i}">${opts}</select></td></tr>`;
          });
          h += "</tbody></table></div>";
        });
        h += '<div id="rekapKompetensi"></div></div>';
        // Tab Program PAI
        h += `<div id="tabProgram" class="tab-content" style="display:none"><div class="card"><h4 style="font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--primary-dark);margin-bottom:4px">Aspek Kualitas Kegiatan Ekstrakurikuler (Kegiatan Inti)</h4><p style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:12px">Menilai interaksi antara guru PAI dan peserta Kegiatan Eskul</p>
  <table class="checklist-table"><thead><tr><th>No</th><th>Komponen Observasi</th><th>Skor</th></tr></thead><tbody>`;
        const progInd = [
          "Penggunaan media pembelajaran inovatif (digital/visual)",
          "Penerapan metode pembelajaran aktif (Student Centered)",
          "Integrasi nilai-nilai karakter (akhlak) dalam setiap materi",
          "Kualitas interaksi dan respon guru terhadap pertanyaan siswa",
          "Evaluasi pembelajaran yang autentik dan edukatif",
        ];
        progInd.forEach((ind, i) => {
          let opts = '<option value="0">-- Pilih --</option>';
          for (let s = 1; s <= 4; s++)
            opts += `<option value="${s}" ${d.programPAI[i] === s ? "selected" : ""}>${s} (${["", "Kurang", "Cukup", "Baik", "Sangat Baik"][s]})</option>`;
          h += `<tr><td>${i + 1}</td><td>${ind}</td><td><select class="level-select" data-field="prog_${i}">${opts}</select></td></tr>`;
        });
        h += `</tbody></table><div id="rekapProgram" style="margin-top:12px"></div></div></div>`;
        // Tab Sarana
        h += `<div id="tabSarana" class="tab-content" style="display:none"><div class="card"><h4 style="font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--primary-dark);margin-bottom:12px">Aspek Sarana dan Prasarana Penunjang</h4><p style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:12px">Menilai fasilitas fisik yang mendukung pengembangan PAI</p>
  <div class="form-group"><label>Ruang Ibadah: Apakah mushola/masjid sekolah bersih, representatif, dan dapat menampung kapasitas siswa?</label><textarea class="form-textarea" data-field="saranaRuang">${esc(d.sarana.ruangIbadah)}</textarea></div>
  <div class="form-group"><label>Perpustakaan: Apakah tersedia literatur keagamaan (buku fikih, sejarah, biografi) yang variatif?</label><textarea class="form-textarea" data-field="saranaPerpus">${esc(d.sarana.perpustakaan)}</textarea></div>
  <div class="form-group"><label>Media/Alat: Apakah tersedia perlengkapan seperti sound system untuk tadarus, alat peraga wudu, atau media digital untuk materi PAI?</label><textarea class="form-textarea" data-field="saranaMedia">${esc(d.sarana.mediaAlat)}</textarea></div>
  </div></div>`;
        // Tab Ekstrakurikuler
        h += `<div id="tabEkskul" class="tab-content" style="display:none"><div class="card"><h4 style="font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--primary-dark);margin-bottom:4px">Aspek Ekstrakurikuler & Pembiasaan (Iklim Sekolah)</h4><p style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:12px">Menilai keberhasilan program di luar jam pelajaran formal</p>
  <table class="checklist-table"><thead><tr><th>Program</th><th>Status</th><th>Frekuensi</th><th>Deskripsi Kegiatan</th></tr></thead><tbody>`;
        d.ekstrakurikuler.forEach((e, i) => {
          h += `<tr><td>${esc(e.program)}</td><td><select class="level-select" data-field="eksStatus_${i}"><option value="">-- Pilih --</option><option value="Aktif" ${e.status === "Aktif" ? "selected" : ""}>Aktif</option><option value="Pasif" ${e.status === "Pasif" ? "selected" : ""}>Pasif</option></select></td>
    <td><input class="form-input" style="min-width:120px" value="${esc(e.frekuensi)}" data-field="eksFreq_${i}"></td>
    <td><input class="form-input" style="min-width:200px" value="${esc(e.deskripsi)}" data-field="eksDesc_${i}"></td></tr>`;
        });
        h += "</tbody></table></div></div>";
        // Tab Refleksi
        h += `<div id="tabRefleksi" class="tab-content" style="display:none"><div class="card"><h4 style="font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--primary-dark);margin-bottom:12px">Lembar Refleksi & Tindak Lanjut</h4>
  <div class="form-group"><label>Catatan Observasi</label><textarea class="form-textarea" data-field="refCatatan">${esc(d.refleksi.catatan)}</textarea></div>
  <div class="form-group"><label>Kekuatan Utama Program</label><textarea class="form-textarea" data-field="refKekuatan">${esc(d.refleksi.kekuatan)}</textarea></div>
  <div class="form-group"><label>Hambatan/Tantangan yang Ditemui</label><textarea class="form-textarea" data-field="refHambatan">${esc(d.refleksi.hambatan)}</textarea></div>
  <div class="form-group"><label>Rekomendasi Tindak Lanjut</label><textarea class="form-textarea" data-field="refRekomendasi">${esc(d.refleksi.rekomendasi)}</textarea></div>
  </div></div>`;
        // Buttons
        h += `<div style="margin-top:20px;display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap">
  <button class="btn btn-primary" data-action="savePenilaian" data-id="${guruId}"><i class="fas fa-save"></i> Simpan Penilaian</button>
  <button class="btn btn-outline" data-action="exportPenilaian" data-id="${guruId}"><i class="fas fa-file-pdf"></i> Export PDF</button>
  <button class="btn btn-outline" data-action="printPenilaian" data-id="${guruId}"><i class="fas fa-print"></i> Cetak A4</button>
  <button class="btn btn-outline" data-action="backPenilaian"><i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i> Kembali</button>
  </div></div>`;
        return h;
      }

  <td><button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline" data-action="binaGuru" data-id="${g.id}"><i class="fas fa-hands-helping"></i> Pembinaan</button></td></tr>`;
        });
        return `<div class="card"><h3 class="section-title">Pembinaan</h3>
  <div style="margin-bottom:16px;max-width:400px"><div class="form-group"><label>Pilih Guru Binaan</label>${guruOpts()}<button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" style="margin-top:8px" data-action="binaSelected"><i class="fas fa-hands-helping"></i> Mulai Pembinaan</button></div></div>

    guru.length
      ? `<table class="data-table"><thead><tr><th>Nama Guru</th><th>Sekolah</th><th>Jumlah Pembinaan</th><th>Status</th><th>Aksi</th></tr></thead><tbody>${list}</tbody></table>`

  }</div>
  </div><div id="binaModal"></div>`;
      }

      /* ===================== EVALUASI ===================== */
      function renderEvaluasi() {
        const guru = realGuru();
        let opts = '<option value="">-- Pilih Guru --</option>';
        guru.forEach(
          g =>
            (opts += `<option value="${g.id}">${g.nama} — ${g.sekolah}</option>`),
        );
        return `<div class="card"><h3 class="section-title">Laporan Evaluasi Pengawasan</h3>
  <p style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:16px">Laporan pelaksanaan Pemantauan, Penilaian, dan Pembinaan terhadap guru binaan</p>
  <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-end;flex-wrap:wrap">
    <div class="form-group" style="margin:0;min-width:300px"><label>Pilih Guru Binaan</label><select class="form-select" id="evalGuruSel">${opts}</select></div>
    <button class="btn btn-primary" data-action="showEvaluasi"><i class="fas fa-search"></i> Tampilkan Laporan</button>
    <button class="btn btn-outline" data-action="exportEvaluasi"><i class="fas fa-file-pdf"></i> Export PDF</button>

  </div></div>
  <div id="evalContent"></div>`;

      function generateEvalHTML(guruId) {
        const g = getGuruById(guruId);
        if (!g)
          return '<div style="text-align:center;padding:40px;color:var(--muted)">Pilih guru binaan</div>';
        const pf = getProfil(),
          rencana = DB.get("rencana_" + guruId),
          pemantauan = DB.get("pemantauan_" + guruId),
          penilaian = DB.get("penilaian_" + guruId),
          pembinaan = DB.get("pembinaan_" + guruId) || [],
          rtl = DB.get("rtl_" + guruId) || [];
        let h = `<div class="card" id="evalReport"><div style="text-align:center;border-bottom:2px solid var(--primary);padding-bottom:16px;margin-bottom:20px">
    <img src="${LOGO}" style="height:70px"><h2 style="font-size:16px;color:var(--primary-dark);margin:8px 0 2px">LAPORAN EVALUASI PENGAWASAN</h2>
    <p style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)">Permenpan RB No. 7 Tahun 2026</p>
    <table style="width:100%;font-size:12px;margin-top:10px;text-align:left"><tr><td style="width:140px">Pengawas PAI</td><td>: ${esc(pf.nama)} (${esc(pf.nip)})</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Guru Binaan</td><td>: ${esc(g.nama)}</td></tr><tr><td>Sekolah</td><td>: ${esc(g.sekolah)} (${g.statusSekolah})</td></tr></table></div>`;
        // Rencana
        h += `<h4 style="font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--primary);margin:16px 0 8px">A. Rencana Kunjungan</h4>`;
        if (rencana)
          h += `<table class="checklist-table"><tr><td>Tanggal</td><td>: ${rencana.tanggal}</td></tr><tr><td>Fokus</td><td>: ${rencana.fokus === "akademik" ? "Supervisi Akademik" : "Supervisi Manajerial"}</td></tr></table>`;
        else
          h +=
            '<p style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)">Belum direncanakan</p>';
        // Pemantauan
        h += `<h4 style="font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--primary);margin:16px 0 8px">B. Pemantauan</h4>`;
        if (pemantauan) {
          h += `<table class="checklist-table"><tr><td>Tanggal</td><td>: ${pemantauan.tanggal}</td></tr><tr><td>Tujuan</td><td>: ${pemantauan.tujuan}</td></tr></table>`;
          if (pemantauan.kelengkapan)
            h += `<p style="font-size:11px;font-weight:600;margin:8px 0 4px">Kelengkapan:</p><ul style="font-size:11px;padding-left:20px">${pemantauan.kelengkapan.rpp ? "<li>Modul Ajar/RPP tersedia</li>" : ""}${pemantauan.kelengkapan.jadwal ? "<li>Jadwal Pelajaran terpampang</li>" : ""}${pemantauan.kelengkapan.absensi ? "<li>Absensi Siswa tercatat</li>" : ""}${pemantauan.kelengkapan.nilai ? "<li>Daftar Nilai tersedia</li>" : ""}</ul>`;
          if (pemantauan.obsAkademik)
            h += `<p style="font-size:11px;font-weight:600;margin:8px 0 4px">Observasi Akademik:</p><div style="font-size:11px;padding-left:16px"><p>Pendahuluan: ${esc(pemantauan.obsAkademik.pendahuluan) || "-"}</p><p>Inti: ${esc(pemantauan.obsAkademik.inti) || "-"}</p><p>Penutup: ${esc(pemantauan.obsAkademik.penutup) || "-"}</p></div>`;
          if (pemantauan.obsManajerial) {
            h += `<p style="font-size:11px;font-weight:600;margin:8px 0 4px">Observasi Manajerial:</p><table class="checklist-table"><thead><tr><th>Indikator</th><th>Ada/Tidak</th><th>Catatan</th></tr></thead><tbody>`;
            pemantauan.obsManajerial.forEach(
              m =>
                (h += `<tr><td>${esc(m.ind)}</td><td>${m.ada || "-"}</td><td>${esc(m.catatan) || "-"}</td></tr>`),
            );
            h += "</tbody></table>";
          }
        } else
          h +=
            '<p style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)">Belum dipantau</p>';
        // Penilaian
        h += `<h4 style="font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--primary);margin:16px 0 8px">C. Penilaian Kompetensi</h4>`;
        if (penilaian) {
          const prClass =
            penilaian.predikatKompetensi === "Paham"
              ? "predikat-paham"
              : penilaian.predikatKompetensi === "Tingkat Dasar"
                ? "predikat-dasar"
                : penilaian.predikatKompetensi === "Tingkat Menengah"
                  ? "predikat-menengah"
                  : penilaian.predikatKompetensi === "Tingkat Mumpuni"
                    ? "predikat-mumpuni"
                    : "predikat-ahli";
          const prClass2 =
            penilaian.predikatProgram === "Kurang"
              ? "predikat-paham"
              : penilaian.predikatProgram === "Cukup"
                ? "predikat-dasar"
                : penilaian.predikatProgram === "Baik"
                  ? "predikat-menengah"
                  : "predikat-mumpuni";
          h += `<div class="rekap-grid"><div><p style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)">Predikat Kompetensi</p><span class="predikat-box ${prClass}">${penilaian.predikatKompetensi || "-"}</span></div>
    <div><p style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)">Predikat Program PAI</p><span class="predikat-box ${prClass2}">${penilaian.predikatProgram || "-"}</span></div></div>`;
        } else
          h += '<p style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)">Belum dinilai</p>';
        // Pembinaan
        h += `<h4 style="font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--primary);margin:16px 0 8px">D. Pembinaan</h4>`;
        if (pembinaan.length) {
          h +=
            '<table class="checklist-table"><thead><tr><th>No</th><th>Tanggal</th><th>Jenis</th><th>Catatan</th><th>Rekomendasi</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
          pembinaan.forEach(
            (pb, i) =>
              (h += `<tr><td>${i + 1}</td><td>${pb.tanggal}</td><td>${pb.jenis}</td><td>${esc(pb.catatan)}</td><td>${esc(pb.rekomendasi)}</td></tr>`),
          );
          h += "</tbody></table>";
        } else
          h +=
            '<p style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)">Belum ada pembinaan</p>';
        // RTL
        h += `<h4 style="font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--primary);margin:16px 0 8px">E. Rencana Tindak Lanjut (RTL)</h4>`;
        if (rtl.length) {
          h +=
            '<table class="checklist-table"><thead><tr><th>No</th><th>What</th><th>Why</th><th>Who</th><th>When</th><th>Where</th><th>How</th></tr></thead><tbody>';
          rtl.forEach(
            (r, i) =>
              (h += `<tr><td>${i + 1}</td><td>${esc(r.what)}</td><td>${esc(r.why)}</td><td>${esc(r.who)}</td><td>${r.when}</td><td>${esc(r.where)}</td><td>${esc(r.how)}</td></tr>`),
          );
          h += "</tbody></table>";
        } else
          h += '<p style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)">Belum ada RTL</p>';
        h += "</div>";
        return h;
      }

  </div></div>`;
      }

      /* ===================== RESET ===================== */
      function renderReset() {
        return `<div class="card" style="max-width:500px;margin:60px auto;text-align:center">
  <i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle" style="font-size:48px;color:var(--danger);margin-bottom:16px"></i>
  <h3 class="section-title" style="display:block">Reset Semua Data</h3>
  <p style="font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:24px">Peringatan: Tindakan ini akan menghapus SELURUH data yang tersimpan, termasuk profil pengawas, data guru binaan, rencana, pemantauan, penilaian, pembinaan, dan RTL. Tindakan ini tidak dapat dibatalkan.</p>
  <button class="btn btn-danger" data-action="confirmReset"><i class="fas fa-trash-alt"></i> Ya, Reset Semua Data</button>
  </div>`;
      }

      /* ===================== EVENT HANDLERS ===================== */
      document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
        const t = e.target.closest("[data-action]");
        if (!t) return;
        const a = t.dataset.action;
        // Navigasi
        if (PAGE_TITLES[a]) {
          navigate(a);
          return;
        }
        switch (a) {
          case "saveProfil": {
            const d = {};
            document.querySelectorAll("[data-field]").forEach(el => {
              if (el.closest(".card")) d[el.dataset.field] = el.value;
            });
            DB.set("profil", d);
            toast("Profil berhasil disimpan");
            break;
          }
          case "exportProfil": {
            exportPDF("Profil Pengawas PAI", buildProfilPDF());
            break;
          }
          case "addGuru": {
            document.getElementById("guruModal").innerHTML = guruFormModal();
            break;
          }
          case "editGuru": {
            const id = t.dataset.id;
            document.getElementById("guruModal").innerHTML = guruFormModal(id);
            break;
          }
          case "delGuru": {
            const id = t.dataset.id,
              g = getGuruById(id);
            showModal(
              `Hapus guru "${g.nama}"?`,
              `Semua data terkait (rencana, pemantauan, penilaian, pembinaan, RTL) akan ikut terhapus.`,
              () => {
                let all = DB.get("guruBinaan") || [];
                all = all.filter(x => x.id !== id);
                DB.set("guruBinaan", all);
                [
                  "rencana_",
                  "pemantauan_",
                  "penilaian_",
                  "pembinaan_",
                  "rtl_",
                ].forEach(p => DB.del(p + id));
                toast("Data guru berhasil dihapus");
                render();
              },
            );
            break;
          }
          case "saveGuru": {
            const id = t.dataset.id;
            let all = DB.get("guruBinaan") || [];
            const obj = {
              ...(id ? getGuruById(id) : {}),
              id: id || uid(),
              nip: document.querySelector('[data-field="gNip"]')?.value || "",
              jenjang: document.querySelector('[data-field="gJenjang"]')?.value || "SMA",
              nama: document.querySelector('[data-field="gNama"]').value,
              sekolah: document.querySelector('[data-field="gSekolah"]').value,
              statusSekolah: document.querySelector('[data-field="gStatus"]')
                .value,
              akreditasi: document.querySelector('[data-field="gAkk"]').value,
            };
            if (!obj.nama || !obj.sekolah) {
              toast("Nama dan sekolah wajib diisi", "error");
              return;
            }
            if (id) {
              const idx = all.findIndex(x => x.id === id);
              if (idx >= 0) all[idx] = {...all[idx], ...obj};
            } else all.push(obj);
            DB.set("guruBinaan", all);
            document.getElementById("guruModal").innerHTML = "";
            toast("Data guru tersimpan");
            render();
            break;
          }
          case "closeGuruModal": {
            document.getElementById("guruModal").innerHTML = "";
            break;
          }
          case "guruPage": {
            guruPage = parseInt(t.dataset.p);
            render();
            break;
          }
          case "exportGuru": {
            exportPDF("Data Guru Binaan", buildGuruPDF());
            break;
          }
          case "planGuru":
          case "planSelected": {
            const sel =
              t.dataset.id ||
              document.querySelector('[data-field="guruId"]')?.value;
            if (!sel) {
              toast("Pilih guru binaan", "warning");
              return;
            }
            document.getElementById("planModal").innerHTML = planFormModal(sel);
            break;
          }
          case "saveRencana": {
            const id = t.dataset.id,
              tgl = document.querySelector('[data-field="rTanggal"]').value,
              fokus = document.querySelector('[data-field="rFokus"]').value;
            if (!tgl || !fokus) {
              toast("Lengkapi tanggal dan fokus", "error");
              return;
            }
            DB.set("rencana_" + id, {...(DB.get("rencana_"+id)||{}), guruId: id, tanggal: tgl, fokus });
            document.getElementById("planModal").innerHTML = "";
            toast("Rencana tersimpan");
            render();
            break;
          }
          case "closePlanModal": {
            document.getElementById("planModal").innerHTML = "";
            break;
          }
          case "exportRencana": {
            exportPDF("Rencana Kunjungan Pengawasan", buildRencanaPDF());
            break;
          }
          case "pantauGuru":
          case "pantauSelected": {
            const sel =
              t.dataset.id ||
              document.querySelector('[data-field="guruId"]')?.value;
            if (!sel) {
              toast("Pilih guru binaan", "warning");
              return;
            }
            document.getElementById("mainContent").innerHTML =
              renderPantauanForm(sel);
            break;
          }
          case "backPemantauan": {
            render();
            break;
          }
          case "savePemantauan": {
            const id = t.dataset.id,
              d = DB.get("pemantauan_" + id) || {};
            d.guruId = id;
            d.tanggal =
              document.querySelector('[data-field="pmTanggal"]')?.value || "";
            d.tujuan =
              document.querySelector('[data-field="pmTujuan"]')?.value || "";
            d.checkStatus = Object.fromEntries([...document.querySelectorAll("[data-check]")].map(el=>[el.dataset.check,el.value]));
            d.kelengkapan = {
              rpp: !!document.querySelector('[data-field="pmRpp"]')?.checked,
              jadwal: !!document.querySelector('[data-field="pmJadwal"]')
                ?.checked,
              absensi: !!document.querySelector('[data-field="pmAbsensi"]')
                ?.checked,
              nilai: !!document.querySelector('[data-field="pmNilai"]')
                ?.checked,
            };
            d.obsAkademik = {
              pendahuluan:
                document.querySelector('[data-field="pmPendahuluan"]')?.value ||
                "",
              inti:
                document.querySelector('[data-field="pmInti"]')?.value || "",
              penutup:
                document.querySelector('[data-field="pmPenutup"]')?.value || "",
            };
            if (!d.obsManajerial)
              d.obsManajerial = [
                {
                  ind: "Tersedia Program Kerja Tahunan pengembangan PAI",
                  ada: "",
                  catatan: "",
                },
                {
                  ind: "Tersedia jadwal kegiatan keagamaan rutin (duha, tadarus, dll)",
                  ada: "",
                  catatan: "",
                },
                { ind: "Tersedia Ruang Ibadah", ada: "", catatan: "" },
                { ind: "Tersedia Lab. PAI", ada: "", catatan: "" },
              ];
            document.querySelectorAll('[data-field="manjAda"]:checked').forEach(el => {
              d.obsManajerial[+el.dataset.idx].ada = "Ada";
            });
            document
              .querySelectorAll('[data-field="manjTidak"]:checked')
              .forEach(el => {
                d.obsManajerial[+el.dataset.idx].ada = "Tidak Ada";
              });
            document
              .querySelectorAll('[data-field="manjCatatan"]')
              .forEach(el => {
                d.obsManajerial[+el.dataset.idx].catatan = el.value;
              });
            if(!d.tanggal || !d.tujuan){toast("Tanggal dan tujuan pemantauan wajib diisi", "error");return;}
            if(d.tujuan!=="manajerial") d.kelengkapan=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(d.checkStatus||{}).map(([k,v])=>[k,v==="ada"]));
            DB.set("pemantauan_" + id, d);
            toast("Data pemantauan tersimpan");
            break;
          }
          case "exportPemantauan": {
            exportPDF(
              "Pemantauan - " + getGuruById(t.dataset.id)?.nama,
              buildPemantauanPDF(t.dataset.id),
            );
            break;
          }
          case "nilaiGuru":
          case "nilaiSelected": {
            const sel =
              t.dataset.id ||
              document.querySelector('[data-field="guruId"]')?.value;
            if (!sel) {
              toast("Pilih guru binaan", "warning");
              return;
            }
            document.getElementById("mainContent").innerHTML =
              renderPenilaianForm(sel);
            setTimeout(updateRekapPenilaian, 100);
            break;
          }
          case "backPenilaian": {
            render();
            break;
          }
          case "savePenilaian": {
            const id = t.dataset.id,
              d = DB.get("penilaian_" + id) || {};
            d.guruId = id;
            ["pedagogik", "kepribadian", "sosial", "profesional"].forEach(k => {
              d[k] = [];
              for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++)
                d[k].push(
                  +(
                    document.querySelector(`[data-field="nilai_${k}_${i}"]`)
                      ?.value || 0
                  ),
                );
            });
            d.programPAI = [];
            for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++)
              d.programPAI.push(
                +(
                  document.querySelector(`[data-field="prog_${i}"]`)?.value || 0
                ),
              );
            // Rekap kompetensi
            const allVals = [
              ...d.pedagogik,
              ...d.kepribadian,
              ...d.sosial,
              ...d.profesional,
            ].filter(v => v > 0);
            const avg = allVals.length
              ? allVals.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / allVals.length
              : 0;
            d.predikatKompetensi =
              avg >= 4.5
                ? "Tingkat Ahli"
                : avg >= 3.5
                  ? "Tingkat Mumpuni"
                  : avg >= 2.5
                    ? "Tingkat Menengah"
                    : avg >= 1.5
                      ? "Tingkat Dasar"
                      : avg > 0
                        ? "Paham"
                        : "";
            // Rekap program
            const pVals = d.programPAI.filter(v => v > 0);
            const pAvg = pVals.length
              ? pVals.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / pVals.length
              : 0;
            d.predikatProgram =
              pAvg >= 3.5
                ? "Sangat Baik"
                : pAvg >= 2.5
                  ? "Baik"
                  : pAvg >= 1.5
                    ? "Cukup"
                    : pAvg > 0
                      ? "Kurang"
                      : "";
            // Sarana
            d.sarana = {
              ruangIbadah:
                document.querySelector('[data-field="saranaRuang"]')?.value ||
                "",
              perpustakaan:
                document.querySelector('[data-field="saranaPerpus"]')?.value ||
                "",
              mediaAlat:
                document.querySelector('[data-field="saranaMedia"]')?.value ||
                "",
            };
            // Ekskul
            const ekskul = [
              { program: "Baca Tulis Al-Qur'an (BTQ)" },
              { program: "Rohani Islam (ROHIS)" },
              { program: "Peringatan Hari Besar Islam" },
              { program: "Kegiatan Sosial/Infaq" },
              { program: "Program Tahfidz/Hafalan" },
            ];
            d.ekstrakurikuler = ekskul.map((e, i) => ({
              program: e.program,
              status:
                document.querySelector(`[data-field="eksStatus_${i}"]`)
                  ?.value || "",
              frekuensi:
                document.querySelector(`[data-field="eksFreq_${i}"]`)?.value ||
                "",
              deskripsi:
                document.querySelector(`[data-field="eksDesc_${i}"]`)?.value ||
                "",
            }));
            // Refleksi
            d.refleksi = {
              catatan:
                document.querySelector('[data-field="refCatatan"]')?.value ||
                "",
              kekuatan:
                document.querySelector('[data-field="refKekuatan"]')?.value ||
                "",
              hambatan:
                document.querySelector('[data-field="refHambatan"]')?.value ||
                "",
              rekomendasi:
                document.querySelector('[data-field="refRekomendasi"]')
                  ?.value || "",
            };
            DB.set("penilaian_" + id, d);
            toast("Penilaian tersimpan");
            updateRekapPenilaian();
            break;
          }
          case "exportPenilaian": {
            exportPDF(
              "Penilaian - " + getGuruById(t.dataset.id)?.nama,
              buildPenilaianPDF(t.dataset.id),
            );
            break;
          }
          case "printPenilaian": {
            printContent(buildPenilaianPDF(t.dataset.id));
            break;
          }
          case "binaGuru":
          case "binaSelected": {
            const sel =
              t.dataset.id ||
              document.querySelector('[data-field="guruId"]')?.value;
            if (!sel) {
              toast("Pilih guru binaan", "warning");
              return;
            }
            document.getElementById("mainContent").innerHTML =
              renderPembinaanForm(sel);
            break;
          }
          case "backPembinaan": {
            render();
            break;
          }
          case "addPembinaan": {
            const id = t.dataset.id,
              list = DB.get("pembinaan_" + id) || [];
            const tgl = document.querySelector(
                '[data-field="binaTanggal"]',
              )?.value,
              jenis = document.querySelector('[data-field="binaJenis"]')?.value,
              cat = document.querySelector('[data-field="binaCatatan"]')?.value,
              rek = document.querySelector(
                '[data-field="binaRekomendasi"]',
              )?.value;
            if (!tgl || !jenis) {
              toast("Tanggal dan jenis wajib diisi", "error");
              return;
            }
            list.push({
              guruId: id,
              tanggal: tgl,
              jenis,
              catatan: cat,
              rekomendasi: rek,
            });
            DB.set("pembinaan_" + id, list);
            toast("Pembinaan ditambahkan");
            render();
            break;
          }
          case "delPembinaan": {
            const id = t.dataset.id,
              idx = +t.dataset.idx,
              list = DB.get("pembinaan_" + id) || [];
            list.splice(idx, 1);
            DB.set("pembinaan_" + id, list);
            toast("Data pembinaan dihapus");
            render();
            break;
          }
          case "exportPembinaan": {
            exportPDF(
              "Pembinaan - " + getGuruById(t.dataset.id)?.nama,
              buildPembinaanPDF(t.dataset.id),
            );
            break;
          }
          case "showEvaluasi": {
            const sel = document.getElementById("evalGuruSel")?.value;
            if (!sel) {
              toast("Pilih guru binaan", "warning");
              return;
            }
            document.getElementById("evalContent").innerHTML =
              generateEvalHTML(sel);
            break;
          }
          case "exportEvaluasi": {
            const sel = document.getElementById("evalGuruSel")?.value;
            if (!sel) {
              toast("Pilih guru binaan", "warning");
              return;
            }
            exportPDF(
              "Laporan Evaluasi - " + getGuruById(sel)?.nama,
              generateEvalHTML(sel),
            );
            break;
          }
          case "printEvaluasi": {
            const sel = document.getElementById("evalGuruSel")?.value;
            if (!sel) {
              toast("Pilih guru binaan", "warning");
              return;
            }
            printContent(generateEvalHTML(sel));
            break;
          }
          case "rtlGuru":
          case "rtlSelected": {
            const sel =
              t.dataset.id ||
              document.querySelector('[data-field="guruId"]')?.value;
            if (!sel) {
              toast("Pilih guru binaan", "warning");
              return;
            }
            document.getElementById("mainContent").innerHTML =
              renderRTLForm(sel);
            break;
          }
          case "backRTL": {
            render();
            break;
          }
          case "addRTL": {
            const id = t.dataset.id,
              list = DB.get("rtl_" + id) || [];
            const w = document.querySelector('[data-field="rtlWhat"]')?.value,
              y = document.querySelector('[data-field="rtlWhy"]')?.value,
              wh = document.querySelector('[data-field="rtlWho"]')?.value,
              wn = document.querySelector('[data-field="rtlWhen"]')?.value,
              wr = document.querySelector('[data-field="rtlWhere"]')?.value,
              h = document.querySelector('[data-field="rtlHow"]')?.value;
            if (!w) {
              toast("What wajib diisi", "error");
              return;
            }
            list.push({
              guruId: id,
              what: w,
              why: y,
              who: wh,
              when: wn,
              where: wr,
              how: h,
            });
            DB.set("rtl_" + id, list);
            toast("RTL ditambahkan");
            render();
            break;
          }
          case "delRTL": {
            const id = t.dataset.id,
              idx = +t.dataset.idx,
              list = DB.get("rtl_" + id) || [];
            list.splice(idx, 1);
            DB.set("rtl_" + id, list);
            toast("RTL dihapus");
            render();
            break;
          }
          case "exportRTL": {
            exportPDF(
              "RTL - " + getGuruById(t.dataset.id)?.nama,
              buildRTLPDF(t.dataset.id),
            );
            break;
          }
          case "printRTL": {
            printContent(buildRTLPDF(t.dataset.id));
            break;
          }
          case "confirmReset": {
            showModal(
              "Konfirmasi Reset Data",
              "SEMUA data akan dihapus permanen. Lanjutkan?",
              () => {
                DB.resetAll();
                toast("Semua data telah direset");
                navigate("dashboard");
              },
            );
            break;
          }
          case "modalCancel": {
            document.getElementById("modalOverlay")?.remove();
            break;
          }
          case "modalConfirm": {
            document
              .getElementById("modalOverlay")
              ?.querySelector("[data-callback]")
              ?.click();
            break;
          }
        }
      });
      // Delegasi perubahan pada pemantauan (tujuan)
      document.addEventListener("change", function (e) {
        if (e.target.id === "pmTujuanSel") {
          const d =
            DB.get(
              "pemantauan_" +
                (document.querySelector('[data-action="savePemantauan"]')
                  ?.dataset.id || ""),
            ) || {};
          d.tujuan = e.target.value;
          d.guruId = d.guruId || "";
          d.tanggal =
            document.querySelector('[data-field="pmTanggal"]')?.value ||
            d.tanggal ||
            "";
          d.kelengkapan = d.kelengkapan || {
            rpp: false,
            jadwal: false,
            absensi: false,
            nilai: false,
          };
          d.obsAkademik = d.obsAkademik || {
            pendahuluan: "",
            inti: "",
            penutup: "",
          };
          d.obsManajerial = d.obsManajerial || [
            {
              ind: "Tersedia Program Kerja Tahunan pengembangan PAI",
              ada: "",
              catatan: "",
            },
            {
              ind: "Tersedia jadwal kegiatan keagamaan rutin (duha, tadarus, dll)",
              ada: "",
              catatan: "",
            },
            { ind: "Tersedia Ruang Ibadah", ada: "", catatan: "" },
            { ind: "Tersedia Lab. PAI", ada: "", catatan: "" },
          ];
          const el = document.getElementById("pmDynamicContent");
          if (el) el.innerHTML = renderPmDynamic(d);
        }
        if (e.target.dataset.field === "searchGuru") {
          searchQ = e.target.value;
          guruPage = 1;
          render();
        }
        // Update rekap penilaian on level change
        if (
          e.target.dataset.field?.startsWith("nilai_") ||
          e.target.dataset.field?.startsWith("prog_")
        )
          setTimeout(updateRekapPenilaian, 50);
      });
      // Tab switching
      document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
        if (e.target.classList.contains("tab-btn")) {
          const parent = e.target.closest(".card");
          if (!parent) return;
          parent
            .querySelectorAll(".tab-btn")
            .forEach(b => b.classList.remove("active"));
          e.target.classList.add("active");
          parent
            .querySelectorAll(".tab-content")
            .forEach(c => (c.style.display = "none"));
          const target = parent.querySelector("#" + e.target.dataset.tab);
          if (target) target.style.display = "block";
        }
      });

      /* ===================== HELPER: MODAL ===================== */
      function showModal(title, msg, onConfirm) {
        const cb = uid();
        document.body.insertAdjacentHTML(
          "beforeend",
          `<div class="modal-overlay" id="modalOverlay"><div class="modal-box">
    <h3 style="font-size:16px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px;color:var(--primary-dark)">${title}</h3>
    <p style="font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:20px">${msg}</p>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end">
      <button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" data-action="modalCancel">Batal</button>
      <button class="btn btn-danger btn-sm" data-action="modalConfirm">Ya, Lanjutkan</button>
    </div>
    <button data-callback="${cb}" style="display:none" id="${cb}"></button>
  </div></div>`,
        );
        document.getElementById(cb).addEventListener("click", () => {
          onConfirm();
          document.getElementById("modalOverlay")?.remove();
        });
      }
      function guruFormModal(editId) {
        const g = editId ? getGuruById(editId) : {};
        return `<div class="modal-overlay" id="modalOverlay"><div class="modal-box" style="max-width:520px">
    <h3 style="font-size:16px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:16px;color:var(--primary-dark)">${editId ? "Edit" : "Tambah"} Guru Binaan</h3>
    <div class="form-group"><label>Nama Guru PAI</label><input class="form-input" data-field="gNama" value="${esc(g.nama)}"></div>
    <div class="form-group"><label>Nama Sekolah</label><input class="form-input" data-field="gSekolah" value="${esc(g.sekolah)}"></div>
    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px">
      <div class="form-group"><label>Status Sekolah</label><select class="form-select" data-field="gStatus"><option value="Negeri" ${g.statusSekolah === "Negeri" ? "selected" : ""}>Negeri</option><option value="Swasta" ${g.statusSekolah === "Swasta" ? "selected" : ""}>Swasta</option></select></div>
      <div class="form-group"><label>Status Akreditasi</label><select class="form-select" data-field="gAkk"><option value="A" ${g.akreditasi === "A" ? "selected" : ""}>A</option><option value="B" ${g.akreditasi === "B" ? "selected" : ""}>B</option><option value="C" ${g.akreditasi === "C" ? "selected" : ""}>C</option><option value="TT" ${g.akreditasi === "TT" ? "selected" : ""}>TT</option><option value="BT" ${g.akreditasi === "BT" ? "selected" : ""}>BT</option></select></div>
    </div>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:8px">
      <button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" data-action="closeGuruModal">Batal</button>
      <button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" data-action="saveGuru" data-id="${editId || ""}"><i class="fas fa-save"></i> Simpan</button>
    </div>
  </div></div>`;
      }
      function planFormModal(guruId) {
        const g = getGuruById(guruId),
          r = DB.get("rencana_" + guruId) || {};
        return `<div class="modal-overlay" id="modalOverlay"><div class="modal-box">
    <h3 style="font-size:16px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:16px;color:var(--primary-dark)">Rencana Kunjungan: ${esc(g.nama)}</h3>
    <div class="form-group"><label>Tanggal Kunjungan</label><input type="date" class="form-input" data-field="rTanggal" value="${r.tanggal || cycle().tanggal || ""}"></div>
    <div class="form-group"><label>Fokus Pengawasan</label><select class="form-select" data-field="rFokus"><option value="">-- Pilih --</option><option value="akademik" ${r.fokus === "akademik" ? "selected" : ""}>Supervisi Akademik</option><option value="manajerial" ${r.fokus === "manajerial" ? "selected" : ""}>Supervisi Manajerial</option></select></div>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end">
      <button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" data-action="closePlanModal">Batal</button>
      <button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" data-action="saveRencana" data-id="${guruId}"><i class="fas fa-save"></i> Simpan</button>
    </div>
  </div></div>`;

      /* ===================== REKAP PENILAIAN ===================== */
      function updateRekapPenilaian() {
        const ped = [],
          kep = [],
          sos = [],
          pro = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
          ped.push(
            +(
              document.querySelector(`[data-field="nilai_pedagogik_${i}"]`)
                ?.value || 0
            ),
          );
          kep.push(
            +(
              document.querySelector(`[data-field="nilai_kepribadian_${i}"]`)
                ?.value || 0
            ),
          );
          sos.push(
            +(
              document.querySelector(`[data-field="nilai_sosial_${i}"]`)
                ?.value || 0
            ),
          );
          pro.push(
            +(
              document.querySelector(`[data-field="nilai_profesional_${i}"]`)
                ?.value || 0
            ),
          );
        }
        const all = [...ped, ...kep, ...sos, ...pro].filter(v => v > 0);
        const avg = all.length
          ? all.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / all.length
          : 0;
        const pred =
          avg >= 4.5
            ? "Tingkat Ahli"
            : avg >= 3.5
              ? "Tingkat Mumpuni"
              : avg >= 2.5
                ? "Tingkat Menengah"
                : avg >= 1.5
                  ? "Tingkat Dasar"
                  : avg > 0
                    ? "Paham"
                    : "";
        const prClass =
          pred === "Paham"
            ? "predikat-paham"
            : pred === "Tingkat Dasar"
              ? "predikat-dasar"
              : pred === "Tingkat Menengah"
                ? "predikat-menengah"
                : pred === "Tingkat Mumpuni"
                  ? "predikat-mumpuni"
                  : pred === "Tingkat Ahli"
                    ? "predikat-ahli"
                    : "";
        const rekapEl = document.getElementById("rekapKompetensi");
        if (rekapEl)
          rekapEl.innerHTML = `<div class="rekap-grid">
    <div><span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)">Rata-rata Level</span><div style="font-size:24px;font-weight:800;color:var(--primary)">${avg ? avg.toFixed(1) : "-"}</div></div>
    <div><span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)">Pedagogik</span><div style="font-size:14px;font-weight:700">${ped.filter(v => v > 0).length ? LEVEL_LABELS[ped.filter(v => v > 0).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / ped.filter(v => v > 0).length - 1] || "-" : "-"}</div></div>
    <div><span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)">Kepribadian</span><div style="font-size:14px;font-weight:700">${kep.filter(v => v > 0).length ? LEVEL_LABELS[Math.round(kep.filter(v => v > 0).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / kep.filter(v => v > 0).length) - 1] || "-" : "-"}</div></div>
    <div><span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)">Sosial</span><div style="font-size:14px;font-weight:700">${sos.filter(v => v > 0).length ? LEVEL_LABELS[Math.round(sos.filter(v => v > 0).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / sos.filter(v => v > 0).length) - 1] || "-" : "-"}</div></div>
    <div><span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)">Profesional</span><div style="font-size:14px;font-weight:700">${pro.filter(v => v > 0).length ? LEVEL_LABELS[Math.round(pro.filter(v => v > 0).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / pro.filter(v => v > 0).length) - 1] || "-" : "-"}</div></div>
    <div><span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)">Predikat Nilai</span><span class="predikat-box ${prClass}" style="margin-top:4px">${pred || "-"}</span></div>
  </div>`;
        // Rekap Program PAI
        const pv = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++)
          pv.push(
            +(document.querySelector(`[data-field="prog_${i}"]`)?.value || 0),
          );
        const pvFiltered = pv.filter(v => v > 0),
          pAvg = pvFiltered.length
            ? pvFiltered.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / pvFiltered.length
            : 0;
        const pPred =
          pAvg >= 3.5
            ? "Sangat Baik"
            : pAvg >= 2.5
              ? "Baik"
              : pAvg >= 1.5
                ? "Cukup"
                : pAvg > 0
                  ? "Kurang"
                  : "";
        const pPrClass =
          pPred === "Kurang"
            ? "predikat-paham"
            : pPred === "Cukup"
              ? "predikat-dasar"
              : pPred === "Baik"
                ? "predikat-menengah"
                : "predikat-mumpuni";
        const rekapProg = document.getElementById("rekapProgram");
        if (rekapProg)
          rekapProg.innerHTML = `<div style="display:flex;gap:20px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap">
    <div><span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)">Rata-rata Skor</span><div style="font-size:24px;font-weight:800;color:var(--primary)">${pAvg ? pAvg.toFixed(1) : "-"}</div></div>
    <div><span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)">Predikat Program</span><span class="predikat-box ${pPrClass}" style="margin-top:4px">${pPred || "-"}</span></div></div>`;
      }

  <p style="margin:0;font-size:10px;color:#666">SMART WASPAI · Sistem Manajemen Aplikasi &amp; Rekam Tugas Pengawasan PAI</p></div>`;
      }

            d.ekstrakurikuler.forEach(

        } else
          h +=
            '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#666">Belum ada data penilaian</p>';
        return h;
      }
      function buildPembinaanPDF(guruId) {
        const g = getGuruById(guruId),
          list = DB.get("pembinaan_" + guruId) || [];
        let h =
          pdfHeader(`PEMBINAAN — ${g.nama}`) +
          `<table style="width:100%;font-size:11px;border-collapse:collapse;margin-bottom:12px"><tr><td style="padding:6px;border:1px solid #ddd;width:160px;background:#f9f9f6;font-weight:600">Guru Binaan</td><td style="padding:6px;border:1px solid #ddd">${esc(g.nama)}</td></tr><tr><td style="padding:6px;border:1px solid #ddd;background:#f9f9f6;font-weight:600">Sekolah</td><td style="padding:6px;border:1px solid #ddd">${esc(g.sekolah)}</td></tr></table>`;
        if (list.length) {
          h += `<table style="width:100%;font-size:11px;border-collapse:collapse"><thead><tr style="background:#0B6E3D;color:#fff"><th style="padding:6px;border:1px solid #ddd">No</th><th style="padding:6px;border:1px solid #ddd">Tanggal</th><th style="padding:6px;border:1px solid #ddd">Jenis</th><th style="padding:6px;border:1px solid #ddd">Catatan</th><th style="padding:6px;border:1px solid #ddd">Rekomendasi</th></tr></thead><tbody>`;
          list.forEach(
            (pb, i) =>
              (h += `<tr><td style="padding:6px;border:1px solid #ddd;text-align:center">${i + 1}</td><td style="padding:6px;border:1px solid #ddd">${pb.tanggal}</td><td style="padding:6px;border:1px solid #ddd">${pb.jenis}</td><td style="padding:6px;border:1px solid #ddd">${esc(pb.catatan) || "-"}</td><td style="padding:6px;border:1px solid #ddd">${esc(pb.rekomendasi) || "-"}</td></tr>`),
          );
          h += "</tbody></table>";
        } else
          h +=
            '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#666">Belum ada data pembinaan</p>';
        return h;
      }
      function buildRTLPDF(guruId) {
        const g = getGuruById(guruId),
          list = DB.get("rtl_" + guruId) || [];
        let h =
          pdfHeader(`RENCANA TINDAK LANJUT — ${g.nama}`) +
          `<table style="width:100%;font-size:11px;border-collapse:collapse;margin-bottom:12px"><tr><td style="padding:6px;border:1px solid #ddd;width:160px;background:#f9f9f6;font-weight:600">Guru Binaan</td><td style="padding:6px;border:1px solid #ddd">${esc(g.nama)}</td></tr><tr><td style="padding:6px;border:1px solid #ddd;background:#f9f9f6;font-weight:600">Sekolah</td><td style="padding:6px;border:1px solid #ddd">${esc(g.sekolah)}</td></tr></table>`;
        if (list.length) {
          h += `<table style="width:100%;font-size:10px;border-collapse:collapse"><thead><tr style="background:#0B6E3D;color:#fff"><th style="padding:6px;border:1px solid #ddd">No</th><th style="padding:6px;border:1px solid #ddd">What</th><th style="padding:6px;border:1px solid #ddd">Why</th><th style="padding:6px;border:1px solid #ddd">Who</th><th style="padding:6px;border:1px solid #ddd">When</th><th style="padding:6px;border:1px solid #ddd">Where</th><th style="padding:6px;border:1px solid #ddd">How</th></tr></thead><tbody>`;
          list.forEach(
            (r, i) =>
              (h += `<tr><td style="padding:5px;border:1px solid #ddd;text-align:center">${i + 1}</td><td style="padding:5px;border:1px solid #ddd">${esc(r.what)}</td><td style="padding:5px;border:1px solid #ddd">${esc(r.why)}</td><td style="padding:5px;border:1px solid #ddd">${esc(r.who)}</td><td style="padding:5px;border:1px solid #ddd;text-align:center">${r.when}</td><td style="padding:5px;border:1px solid #ddd">${esc(r.where)}</td><td style="padding:5px;border:1px solid #ddd">${esc(r.how)}</td></tr>`),
          );
          h += "</tbody></table>";
        } else h += '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#666">Belum ada RTL</p>';
        return h;
      }

      /* ===================== EXPORT & PRINT ===================== */
      function exportPDF(title, htmlContent) {
        const c = document.getElementById("pdfContainer");
        c.innerHTML = `<div style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;padding:20mm;font-size:11px;color:#1F2937;line-height:1.5">${htmlContent}</div>`;
        html2pdf()
          .set({
            margin: [10, 10, 10, 10],
            filename: title + ".pdf",
            image: { type: "jpeg", quality: 0.95 },
            html2canvas: { scale: 2, useCORS: true, logging: false },
            jsPDF: { unit: "mm", format: "a4", orientation: "portrait" },
          })
          .from(c.firstElementChild)
          .save()
          .then(() => toast("PDF berhasil diunduh"));
      }
      function printContent(htmlContent) {
        const w = window.open("", "_blank");
        w.document.write(
          `<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><title>Cetak</title><link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"><style>@page{size:A4;margin:15mm}body{font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;font-size:11px;color:#1F2937;line-height:1.5}table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%}th,td{padding:6px;border:1px solid #ddd}thead tr{background:#0B6E3D;color:#fff}img{height:70px}h2{color:#0B6E3D;font-size:15px;margin:8px 0 2px}h4{color:#0B6E3D;font-size:12px;margin:12px 0 6px}</style></head><body>${htmlContent}</body></html>`,
        );
        w.document.close();
        w.setTimeout(() => w.print(), 500);
      }

      function idb(){return new Promise((ok,no)=>{const r=indexedDB.open("sitkapai_files",1);r.onupgradeneeded=()=>r.result.createObjectStore("files",{keyPath:"id"});r.onsuccess=()=>ok(r.result);r.onerror=()=>no(r.error)})}
      async function putFile(o){const db=await idb();return new Promise((ok,no)=>{const tx=db.transaction("files","readwrite");tx.objectStore("files").put(o);tx.oncomplete=ok;tx.onerror=()=>no(tx.error)})}
      async function getFile(id){const db=await idb();return new Promise((ok,no)=>{const r=db.transaction("files").objectStore("files").get(id);r.onsuccess=()=>ok(r.result);r.onerror=()=>no(r.error)})}
      async function removeFile(id){const db=await idb();return new Promise((ok,no)=>{const tx=db.transaction("files","readwrite");tx.objectStore("files").delete(id);tx.oncomplete=ok;tx.onerror=()=>no(tx.error)})}

      async function extractFile(file){const ext=file.name.split(".").pop().toLowerCase(),buf=await file.arrayBuffer();if(["xlsx","xls","csv"].includes(ext)&&window.XLSX){const wb=XLSX.read(buf,{type:"array"}),ws=wb.Sheets[wb.SheetNames[0]],json=XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(ws,{defval:""});return{ringkasan:`${json.length} baris · Sheet: ${wb.SheetNames.join(", ")}`,rows:json}}if(ext==="docx"&&window.mammoth){const r=await mammoth.extractRawText({arrayBuffer:buf});return{ringkasan:r.value.replace(/\s+/g," ").slice(0,500),text:r.value}}if(ext==="pdf"&&window.pdfjsLib){pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc="data:application/javascript;base64,";const pdf=await pdfjsLib.getDocument({data:buf}).promise;let text="";for(let p=1;p<=Math.min(pdf.numPages,40);p++){const c=await(await pdf.getPage(p)).getTextContent();text+=c.items.map(i=>i.str).join(" ")+"\n"}return{ringkasan:`${pdf.numPages} halaman · `+text.replace(/\s+/g," ").slice(0,420),text}}return{ringkasan:"Berkas tersimpan sebagai bukti digital."}}

function stateOf(id){const g=getGuruById(id),t=DB.get('temuan_'+id)||{},n=DB.get('penilaian_'+id),r=DB.get('rtl_'+id)||[],pb=DB.get('pembinaan_'+id)||[],pm=DB.get('pemantauan_'+id);const inds=indicators(g),need=inds.filter(([k])=>t[k]?.status==='perlu'),good=inds.filter(([k])=>t[k]?.status==='baik'),unknown=inds.filter(([k])=>!t[k]?.status||t[k]?.status==='belum'),na=inds.filter(([k])=>t[k]?.status==='na');const a=assessment(n||{});const issues=[];if(!g?.jenjang)issues.push('Jenjang guru belum diisi.');if(!pm?.tanggal||!pm?.tujuan)issues.push('Pemantauan bertanggal dan bertujuan belum disimpan.');if(!n||!a.complete||!a.program.complete)issues.push('Penilaian guru/program belum lengkap.');if(n&&[...['pedagogik','kepribadian','sosial','profesional'].flatMap(k=>n[k]||[]),...(n.programPAI||[])].includes(-1)&&!n.naReason?.trim())issues.push('Alasan indikator penilaian tidak relevan belum dicatat.');if(unknown.length)issues.push(unknown.length+' indikator temuan belum diamati/diisi.');inds.forEach(([k,label])=>{const x=t[k];if(x?.status==='na'&&!x.catatan?.trim())issues.push('Alasan tidak relevan: '+label);if(['baik','perlu'].includes(x?.status)&&!x.catatan?.trim())issues.push('Catatan bukti: '+label);if(x?.docId&&!(DB.get('dokumen')||[]).some(d=>d.id===x.docId))issues.push('Lampiran temuan tidak ditemukan: '+label)});return{g,t,n,r,pb,pm,inds,need,good,unknown,na,a,issues}}

async function allFiles(){const db=await idb();return new Promise((ok,no)=>{const r=db.transaction('files').objectStore('files').getAll();r.onsuccess=()=>ok(r.result);r.onerror=()=>no(r.error)})}
function asBase64(blob){return new Promise((ok,no)=>{const r=new FileReader();r.onload=()=>ok(r.result.split(',')[1]);r.onerror=()=>no(r.error);r.readAsDataURL(blob)})}
function decodeBlob(b64,type){const bytes=Uint8Array.from(atob(b64),c=>c.charCodeAt(0));return new Blob([bytes],{type})}
exportBackup=async function(){try{const records={};DB.allKeys().forEach(full=>{const k=full.slice(9);if(k!=='beforeRestore')records[k]=rawGet(k)});const files=[];for(const f of await allFiles())files.push({id:f.id,nama:f.nama,type:f.type,data:await asBase64(f.blob)});downloadBlob('SMART_WASPAI_Cadangan_Lengkap.json','application/json',JSON.stringify({format:'SMART-WASPAI-2026.2',exportedAt:new Date().toISOString(),records,files}));toast('Cadangan lengkap data dan berkas berhasil dibuat')}catch(e){toast('Cadangan gagal: '+e.message,'error')}};
async function restoreBackup(file){const d=JSON.parse(await file.text());if(!d.records||typeof d.records!=='object'||Array.isArray(d.records))throw Error('Struktur cadangan tidak valid');if(d.format!=='SMART-WASPAI-2026.2'&&d.version!=='SMART-WASPAI-2026.1')throw Error('Versi cadangan tidak dikenali');const entries=Object.entries(d.records);for(const [k,v]of entries){if(!/^[A-Za-z0-9_\-]+$/.test(k)||['__proto__','constructor','prototype'].includes(k))throw Error('Kunci cadangan tidak valid');}if(d.format&&(!Array.isArray(d.files)||!Array.isArray(d.records.cycles)||!Array.isArray(d.records.guruBinaan)))throw Error('Cadangan lengkap tidak memiliki indeks yang sah');const decoded=[];for(const f of d.files||[]){if(!f.id||typeof f.data!=='string'||typeof f.nama!=='string')throw Error('Lampiran cadangan tidak valid');decoded.push({id:f.id,nama:f.nama,type:f.type||'',blob:decodeBlob(f.data,f.type||'')})}for(const key of ['cycles','guruBinaan','dokumen']){if(Array.isArray(d.records[key])){const merged=new Map((rawGet(key)||[]).map(x=>[x.id,x]));d.records[key].forEach(x=>merged.set(x.id,x));d.records[key]=[...merged.values()]}}const before={};DB.allKeys().forEach(k=>{if(k.slice(9)!=='beforeRestore')before[k.slice(9)]=rawGet(k.slice(9))});rawSet('beforeRestore',{at:new Date().toISOString(),records:before});const db=await idb();await new Promise((ok,no)=>{const tx=db.transaction('files','readwrite');const store=tx.objectStore('files');decoded.forEach(f=>store.put(f));tx.oncomplete=ok;tx.onerror=()=>no(tx.error);tx.onabort=()=>no(tx.error)});try{entries.forEach(([k])=>rawSet(k,d.records[k]));if(d.version==='SMART-WASPAI-2026.1'){rawDel('cycles');rawDel('activeCycle')}initV2()}catch(e){entries.forEach(([k])=>rawDel(k));Object.entries(before).forEach(([k,v])=>rawSet(k,v));throw e}toast(d.version?'Data lama dipulihkan; lampiran asli tidak disertakan cadangan lama.':'Cadangan data dan berkas berhasil dipulihkan');navigate('dashboard')}

function engineCompose(id,e=engineData(id)){const g=getGuruById(id),facts=engineFacts(id,e),need=facts.filter(f=>f.status==='perlu'),good=facts.filter(f=>f.status==='baik'),unknown=facts.filter(f=>f.status==='belum'),na=facts.filter(f=>f.status==='na');const active=facts.filter(f=>f.status!=='belum');const desc=(active.map((f,i)=>(i+1)+'. '+f.label+': '+f.deskripsi).join('\n\n')||'Belum ada kondisi yang diperiksa untuk dirumuskan.')+(unknown.length?'\n\n'+unknown.length+' aspek lainnya belum diamati dan tidak dinilai pada cakupan ini.':'');const proof=active.map((f,i)=>(i+1)+'. '+f.label+' — '+f.bukti).join('\n\n')||'Belum ada pemeriksaan yang dikonfirmasi.';const rekom=active.map((f,i)=>(i+1)+'. '+f.label+': '+f.rekom).join('\n\n')||'Lengkapi pengamatan sebelum menetapkan kebutuhan pembinaan.';const focus=need.length?need.map(f=>f.label).join('; '):'pemeliharaan praktik baik dan refleksi hasil pengawasan';let bina=e.binaDone?'Pada '+e.binaTanggal+', pengawas mengonfirmasi pelaksanaan '+e.coaching.toLowerCase()+' bersama '+(g?.nama||'guru')+' di '+(g?.sekolah||'sekolah')+'. Fokus pembinaan: '+focus+'. '+(need.length?'Pendampingan diarahkan pada '+need.map(f=>f.r.aksi.charAt(0).toLowerCase()+f.r.aksi.slice(1)).join(' '):'Pengawas dan guru meninjau konsistensi praktik yang telah dicatat.')+' Respons guru yang dipilih pengawas: '+e.response+'. '+(e.response==='Belum dinilai'?'Perubahan praktik belum disimpulkan; perlu pemeriksaan tindak lanjut.':'Respons tersebut perlu dibedakan dari bukti keberhasilan penerapan di kelas.'):'Rencana pembinaan melalui '+e.coaching.toLowerCase()+' untuk '+focus+'. Kegiatan belum ditandai terlaksana; narasi ini belum menjadi catatan pembinaan aktual.';const rtl=need.map((f,i)=>(i+1)+'. Apa: '+f.r.aksi+'\nMengapa: '+f.r[e.items[f.key]?.condition||'parsial']+'\nSiapa: '+g?.nama+' bersama pengawas dan pihak terkait sesuai kewenangan.\nKapan: '+e.deadline+' (jadwal tindak lanjut yang dapat disesuaikan).\nDi mana: '+g?.sekolah+'.\nBagaimana: '+f.r.adaptasi+'; '+f.r.asesmen+'.\nIndikator keberhasilan: '+f.r.indikator+'\nBukti hasil yang diperiksa: '+f.r.hasil+'.').join('\n\n')||'Belum ada kebutuhan perbaikan yang ditetapkan dari kondisi terpilih. Pertahankan praktik baik dan lengkapi aspek yang belum diamati.';const simp='Pada '+e.tanggal+', pengawasan PAI terhadap '+g?.nama+' di '+g?.sekolah+' mencatat '+good.length+' aspek dengan kondisi baik, '+need.length+' aspek memerlukan penguatan, '+unknown.length+' aspek belum diamati, dan '+na.length+' aspek tidak relevan. '+(need.length?'Prioritas: '+need.map(f=>f.label.toLowerCase()).join('; ')+'. ':'Belum ada prioritas perbaikan yang ditetapkan dari kondisi terpilih. ')+(e.verified&&e.sumber?'Pemeriksaan sumber bukti dikonfirmasi pengawas. ':'Pemeriksaan sumber bukti belum dikonfirmasi; seluruh redaksi masih berupa draf. ')+(e.binaDone?'Pembinaan telah ditandai dilaksanakan melalui '+e.coaching.toLowerCase()+'. ':'Pembinaan belum ditandai dilaksanakan. ')+(e.cakupan==='menyeluruh'?'Cakupan kunjungan menyeluruh. ':'Laporan kunjungan terfokus: aspek yang belum diamati tidak dinilai dan tidak diperlakukan sebagai kelemahan. ')+'Penilaian pada alur ini bersifat kualitatif; skor angka tidak dibuat dari narasi.';const out={deskripsi:desc,bukti:proof,pembinaan:bina,rekomendasi:rekom,rtl,simpulan:simp};for(const[k,v]of Object.entries(e.overrides||{}))if(v.signature===engineSourceSignature(e)&&v.text?.trim())out[k]=v.text;return{...out,facts,need,good,unknown,na}}
const ENGINE_OUTPUTS=[['deskripsi','Deskripsi hasil pengawasan'],['bukti','Catatan bukti'],['pembinaan','Catatan / rencana pembinaan'],['rekomendasi','Rekomendasi'],['rtl','RTL lengkap & indikator keberhasilan'],['simpulan','Simpulan laporan']];
function engineIssues(id,e=engineData(id)){const a=engineCompose(id,e),issues=[];if(!e.tanggal)issues.push('Pilih tanggal pengawasan.');if(!e.sumber||!e.verified)issues.push('Pilih sumber dan konfirmasikan pemeriksaan bukti.');if(!a.facts.some(f=>f.known))issues.push('Pilih sekurang-kurangnya satu kondisi yang benar-benar diperiksa.');if(a.unknown.length&&e.cakupan==='menyeluruh')issues.push(a.unknown.length+' aspek belum diamati; laporan final menunggu pelengkapan atau penentuan relevansi.');for(const f of a.na)if(!f.x.reason)issues.push('Pilih alasan tidak relevan untuk '+f.label+'.');for(const f of a.facts){const docId=f.x.docId||e.docId;if(docId&&!(DB.get('dokumen')||[]).some(x=>x.id===docId))issues.push('Lampiran tidak ditemukan untuk '+f.label+'.');if(f.x.progress==='terverifikasi'&&(!f.confirmed||f.status!=='baik'))issues.push('RTL '+f.label+' belum dapat diverifikasi selesai: perlu kondisi baik dan pemeriksaan bukti.')}if(e.binaDone&&!e.binaTanggal)issues.push('Tanggal pembinaan yang benar-benar dilaksanakan belum dipilih.');return issues}
function enginePreview(id){const e=engineData(id),a=engineCompose(id,e),issues=engineIssues(id,e);return `<div class="engine-result-head"><span class="status-chip info">Draf mesin · ${a.good.length} baik · ${a.need.length} perlu penguatan</span><p>${issues.length?issues.map(esc).join('<br>'):'Pilihan fakta siap diterapkan dan diperiksa pengawas.'}</p></div>`+ENGINE_OUTPUTS.map(([k,l])=>`<details class="engine-output" ${k==='deskripsi'||k==='simpulan'||k==='rekomendasi'?'open':''}><summary>${l}</summary><p style="white-space:pre-line">${esc(a[k])}</p><button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" data-action="copyEngine" data-key="${k}">Salin narasi</button><details><summary>Koreksi redaksi (opsional)</summary><textarea class="form-textarea" data-engine-note="${k}" rows="6">${esc(e.overrides?.[k]?.text||'')}</textarea><small>Perubahan pilihan fakta akan memakai redaksi mesin yang baru. Koreksi lama tetap tersedia di kolom ini untuk diperiksa ulang.</small></details></details>`).join('')}
